request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only lovelace removed from the Cardano Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returned Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada limit and are not reset, reversed, reopened, or reauthorized by this action.
The proposal supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epochs 613-713 period, including the previously agreed 350,000,000 ada limit referenced in the motivation.
The existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has served as a useful fiscal guardrail, but practical room under it is becoming constrained through mid-2027.
The action records DRep agreement when Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake, identified as the TREASURY-01a threshold for agreeing a Net Change Limit.
The Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The action is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, with an IPFS reference provided for the Constitution.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to replace the prior Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 with a 500,000,000 ada cap, defines how debited withdrawals count against it, excludes inflows, preserves DRep discretion over later withdrawals, and asserts constitutional compliance.
